info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cancellations Management API
info.description: The Cancellations Management API allows businesses to effectively manage the cancellation of servicing orders. This endpoint enables users to process cancellation requests for specific orders, ensuring streamlined handling of customer service operations. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and automated systems that require order modifications. Through this API, organizations can enhance customer satisfaction by facilitating timely responses to cancellation inquiries.

post.summary: Cancel a servicing order with the given ID.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a servicing order identified by its unique ID. It initiates the cancellation process and returns the appropriate response based on the success or failure of the operation.
